exposure: breastfeeding success in the early postpartum period
cohort: Primiparous mothers who delivered a single healthy term baby at or after 37 weeks gestation
finding: Primiparous mothers who had high breastfeeding success in the early postpartum period experienced fewer breast problems and had higher breastfeeding self-efficacy in the late postpartum period
mod_finding: Mothers who gave birth vaginally had higher breastfeeding success
